verdict.line: You lose this lane when you auto-trade or swing W into a fresh Counter Strike (E); you win it by poking with Sky Splitter (E) on his cooldowns and landing the double-W heal in every short trade.

brief.thesis: Jax's Counter Strike (E) dodges exactly the basic attacks that Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) and trades are built around, which is why Jax holds both the lane and solo-kill edge across the measured 240 games. Volibear's counter is that Sky Splitter (E) is a targeted lightning bolt, not an attack, so it still lands through the dodge window. That gives Volibear enough poke and sustain to keep the matchup at an even 47.5% win rate instead of a clear loss.

theirWindow.what: Do not swing Q, W, or autos into the stance — he dodges all incoming basic attacks for its duration and then stuns and damages everyone around him when it ends. Walk off and reset instead of feeding him the stun.

yourWindow.what: This is your trade window. Open with Q (Thundering Smash) for the stun, then land W (Frenzied Maul) twice on the marked target for the bonus damage and heal before he can reset with Leap Strike (Q).

start.item: Doran's Ring > Health Potion > Health Potion
start.why: The most-picked start in this matchup (68.9% pick, 44.1% WR over 222 games); the mana sustain keeps you recasting W (Frenzied Maul) for the heal and throwing Sky Splitter (E) pokes instead of sitting on cooldown during his Leap Strike windows.

boots.why: Most-picked boots in the matchup (52.2% pick, 45.5% WR); cuts the physical damage from his autos and from Relentless Assault (R) stacking once fights go long.

core.why: On-hit base that scales directly with W (Frenzied Maul)'s on-hit application and marks.
Cooldown refund on hits keeps your 5s W and 16s Sky Splitter cycling faster than his Leap Strike and Counter Strike can reset.
Amplifies the self-heal on W's recast, letting you out-sustain his Empower pokes through extended trades.

situational.when: you need extra wave clear and poke pressure before your item spike
the fight drags into extended skirmishes and you need more sustain
jax rushes attack speed or crit to maximize Relentless Assault stacking

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp procs off your basic attacks and heals you while raising your max health, stacking with the W (Frenzied Maul) double-tap heal so you can out-sustain his Leap Strike and Empower burst rather than racing his all-in; this page also carries the better measured win rate of the two listed (45.7% vs 38.6%).

summoners.why: Flash and Teleport post the best measured win rate in this matchup (47.1%), letting you reset after trades and still be back for his Counter Strike-heavy all-in windows; Flash and Ignite (43.2% WR, the most-picked combo) is the alternative if you'd rather force kills off your Q stun before level 6.

playing.title: Bait Leap Strike, not Counter Strike
playing.detail: Jax's Q (Leap Strike) is back up in as little as 5s at max rank, so punishing it on cooldown with your Q (Thundering Smash) stun is far safer than trading into a fresh Counter Strike (E).

playing.title: Never auto into fresh Counter Strike
playing.detail: Counter Strike (E) dodges all incoming basic attacks for its duration, so swinging W or autos the instant he activates it just wastes your cooldown; punish the stun window after it ends instead.

playing.title: Poke with Sky Splitter on his cooldowns
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (E) is a targeted bolt, not a basic attack, so it goes through Counter Strike's dodge; fire it whenever both his Leap Strike (Q) and Counter Strike (E) are down.

playing.title: Double-tap W for the heal
playing.detail: Recasting W (Frenzied Maul) on the same marked target deals bonus damage and heals you, so land it twice in every trade you commit to.

playing.title: Shorten trades at levels 3-5
playing.detail: Once Jax ranks Empower (W), its cooldown drops to 6s then 5s, letting him threaten burst far more often than Counter Strike alone; favor quick pokes over extended duels in this window.

playing.title: Hold Stormbringer for picks, not pokes
playing.detail: R (Stormbringer) sits at a 160s cooldown at rank 1, so don't burn it contesting a single Leap Strike; save it to zone him off a low-health ally or disable a tower he's diving.

playing.title: Trade through Grasp, stay in auto range
playing.detail: Grasp of the Undying only procs off basic attacks, so stay in melee range during extended fights rather than kiting with abilities alone, letting Second Wind and Shield Bash pad your sustain back.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and the 47.5% head-to-head / 48.4% overall win rates are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning about Counter Strike, Sky Splitter, and the trade windows is my own read of the ability text, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid using [Q][W] when Jax is using Counter Strike (E). Use [E] to contest lane and close in when the enemy’s abilities are on cooldown to engage.
